race.comment: BRIGHT PROMISE (8) opened this prep with a couple of wins and has been about the mark since. Raced handy and tried hard but just missed the placings last start over this course and distance. Gets some weight relief today but takes on the boys. Just needs luck from a wide draw to play a prominent role again. AHELLBENDA (6) came wide and did her best work late to finish sixth when resuming here at this trip recently. Useful mare with each-way claims. Lightly raced four-year-old VIIPURI (4) has been safely held in two runs this prep. Can improve on those efforts with a good gate for a change. KITTY OKAY (3) may need one more run but she gets in well after the claim so should improve on a modest first-up effort.
